subject: geom_bar won't appear when  adding ylim

messages.author: 7c0386eb50d3c55c
messages.subject: geom_bar won't appear when  adding ylim
parts:
Hello,

I can get basic bar charts to appear. But, if I limit the y scale,
the bars do not appear.

Could someone kindly explain what I'm doing wrong.

require(ggplot2)
frame <- data.frame(x=seq(1,4), y=c(-940, -900, -1000, -999))
#works
ggplot() + geom_bar(data=frame, aes(x,y ), stat="identity")
#doesn't work
ggplot() + geom_bar(data=frame, aes(x,y ), stat="identity") + ylim
(-900, -1100)

Thanks very much

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: geom_bar won't appear when adding ylim
parts:
Yes, this is the normal behaviour with scales - anything outside the
limits is not shown. You probably want the xlim and ylim parameters
to coord_cartesian.

Hadley
